final_draft.answer: Yes, for employees. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor. Our Access Control Policy also states that all workforce members must authenticate with a second factor.
final_draft.note: This only partly matches the question. The approved answer covers employees only and says nothing about contractors. The Access Control Policy (section 4.2) says 'all workforce members', but neither source defines 'workforce members' or says whether it covers contractors. So the answer doesn't state that contractors are covered. A reviewer should confirm with the answer owner (security@harborlight.example) whether contractors use MFA through the identity provider. If they do, the answer can say so; if not, the gap should be disclosed. I didn't run any live checks because none of them looks at MFA for workforce or identity-provider accounts.
